svg.title: One landmark array, two anatomical selections
svg.desc: Three front-facing schematic skeletons show all 33 MediaPipe positions, 12 gait landmarks used by historical target eligibility and VICReg pooling, and 10 landmarks in the five-pair raw observed laterality target. No landmarks are deleted from the input; hips define the pelvis reference.

text.tspan: One landmark array, two anatomical selections
Highlighting selects a use for a point; all 33 positions stay in the input.
Front view: the person's left appears on the viewer's right.
The two selections answer different questions
Training: historical target eligibility and VICReg use the 12 gait points.
Latest motion / region samplers can select other body tokens.
Target: use observed timestamps before interpolation or 64-frame resizing.
